visualCharacteristics: Collapsible accordion of Q&A pairs. Each item shows a question as a clickable header with a chevron; clicking expands the answer panel below. Bordered items stacked vertically.
contentPattern: Repeating rows; each row = 2 cells: cell 1 = question (label), cell 2 = answer (body content).
usage: FAQ sections and any collapsible question/answer or show/hide content list.
